sub_parameters.name: cluster
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster to be authorized.

- If the value of the `role_type` parameter is `all-clusters`, set this parameter to an empty string.

sub_parameters.name: is_custom
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether the authorization is a custom authorization, which means `role_name` uses a custom ClusterRole name.

sub_parameters.name: is_ram_role
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether the authorization is for a RAM role.

sub_parameters.name: namespace
sub_parameters.description: The namespace name. This parameter is empty by default for cluster-level authorization.

sub_parameters.name: role_name
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the preset role. Valid values:

- `admin`: administrator.
- `admin-view`: read-only administrator.
- `ops`: O&M engineer.
- `dev`: developer.
- `restricted`: restricted user.
- Custom ClusterRole name.

><notice>

- `admin`, `admin-view`, `ops`: cannot be granted at the namespace level.
- `admin-view`: cannot be granted at the all-clusters level.
></notice>.

sub_parameters.name: role_type
sub_parameters.description:
The authorization type. Valid values:

- `cluster`: cluster level.
- `namespace`: namespace level.
- `all-clusters`: all-clusters level.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: The ID of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role.
